item.title: Café Reel From Owner Photos

turns.text: These are photos of my café. Make a cosy 9-second vertical Instagram reel using all three, storefront first. Gentle movement, soft upbeat music, no talking. Put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end.

item.tests: Tests a short, cohesive local-business promo that preserves the owner's actual photos across mixed source aspect ratios.

answer_sheet.Business and exact wording: Maple Street Café; opening text: Maple Street Café; closing text: Your morning starts here.
answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all three attached photos. Start with the storefront; the order of the latte and pastries is your call.
answer_sheet.Style and movement: Cosy, warm and inviting, with gentle movement. Transition choices are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Soft upbeat music, no talking. English text.

must_haves: The reel starts with the attached café storefront, retaining its striped awning and outdoor tables.
Both the attached leaf-foam latte and the attached pastry counter are recognisable in later shots.
The opening text reads exactly 'Maple Street Café' and the closing text reads exactly 'Your morning starts here'.
The photos have gentle visible movement and are framed without stretching.
The finished reel is vertical, lasts approximately 9 seconds, and has soft upbeat music with no speech.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a 9-second vertical Instagram cafe promotional reel using all three supplied photographs, in this exact sequence. Treat them as photo montage shots; preserve the actual storefront, latte and pastries from the references, do not invent replacement scenes. 0–3 seconds: @storefront photo with gentle slow push-in, overlaid clear elegant readable text exactly "Maple Street Café" centered within Instagram safe margins. 3–6 seconds: clean quick cut to @latte photo, gentle push-in on the latte and its leaf latte art. 6–9 seconds: clean quick cut to @pastries photo with subtle camera drift over the croissants, overlay clear readable text exactly "Your morning starts here" through the final frame. Warm inviting natural morning tones, restrained polished editing, no extra text, no narration. Crop each image thoughtfully to fill 9:16 without stretching. Keep important photo subjects and text inside safe margins.
